🍽️ Portion Sharing Guidelines

1 : 2

Soups only. A soup ordered for 1 may be shared by 2 guests.

All other dishes

Sharing on a 1 : 2 basis is not permitted. Permitted sharing:

2 : 3

Dish ordered for 2 may be shared by 3 guests.

3 : 5

Dish ordered for 3 may be shared by 5 guests.
